route_decision.instructions: Which route option should handle `task`? Choose the least costly option that can reliably complete it.

criteria.option_0: gemini-3.8-flash-low via agy. Cheapest worker for trivial bounded tasks such as typos and renames.
criteria.option_1: gpt-6.1-sol via codex. Deepest worker for subtle bugs, security and architecture; overkill for small edits.
